name: Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD.
summary: Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD. engages in the operation of Talking Tom and Friends franchise in China and internationally. The company also develops various educational, entertaining, and educational green and healthy mobile application products under the Talking Tom Adventure, My Angela 2, My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom 2, Talking Tom Gold Run, and Talking Tom Hero Parkour names. In addition, it is involved in content production, distribution, and operation; operates multi-function indoor theme park, including Talking Tom Brave Adventure Zone; and IP derivatives and licensing activities.
